clock_quality.rule: row availability is the actual's availability; consensus_quality names the consensus provenance (exact only for consensus captured by our timer before the release, unvintaged otherwise)

columns.meaning: figure of the release (nfp_change, cpi_mom, ism_mfg_pmi, ...)
columns.name: measure

columns.meaning: scheduled release instant (the actual's available_utc when published, else the schedule)
columns.name: release_utc

columns.meaning: latest exact consensus captured before release_utc, else latest unvintaged consensus
columns.name: consensus

columns.meaning: when that consensus row was captured
columns.name: consensus_captured_utc

columns.meaning: prior-period figure shown at the release (same source as the actual when available)
columns.name: previous

columns.meaning: (surprise - median) / (1.4826 * MAD) over the trailing 36 earlier surprises of the same measure; null when fewer than 8 or MAD is 0
columns.name: surprise_z

columns.meaning: number of earlier surprises used for surprise_z
columns.name: n_trailing

columns.meaning: when the actual became available (from the vintage row); null when only the day is known
columns.name: available_utc

columns.meaning: unit of actual, consensus, previous and surprise
columns.name: unit

notes.surprise_z: robust z over the trailing 36 earlier surprises of the same measure, past only, min 8
notes.units: actual, consensus, previous and surprise all carry the measure's one registered unit (swing_dataset.calendar.units.MEASURE_UNITS); the build raises rather than differencing unlike quantities
